children: Polkadot is pushing to introduce dotUSD, a dollar-pegged stablecoin backed by its native DOT token.

BlockchainReporter reported on November 14 that Polkadot Community Foundation's new ecosystem strategy, which includes the dotUSD rollout plan, was approved in a decentralized governance vote on November 11 with 97% support.
The foundation plans to structure the stablecoin so that demand for DOT rises as use of stablecoins expands.

Polkadot also plans to develop a mobile application supporting peer-to-peer messaging and digital cash payments. The move reflects a shift away from its existing developer-focused ecosystem expansion strategy toward attracting mainstream users.

However, details including dotUSD's collateral ratio, issuance and redemption mechanism, and launch schedule have not been disclosed. A decline in Polkadot's price could also reduce the value of the stablecoin's collateral, posing a risk.

title: Polkadot Pushes to Introduce DOT-Backed Stablecoin dotUSD
